jobs.description: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. Job Category Finance and Accounting Target Openings 1 What Is the Opportunity? You will be responsible for cashiering activities for Travelers Insurance Company, Travelers Insurance Designated Activity Company and Travelers Legal Ltd. Your primary remit will include receipting and processing insurance payment transactions across multiple bank accounts, ensuring accuracy, control and timely posting. Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do? Ensure that insurance cash payments and receipting functions operate in line with in-force SLAs with business users. Ensure that automated and manual cash-related financial ledger postings are correctly allocated by legal entity and are processed within required deadlines. Follow up on head-office generated bank reconciliation queries in a timely manner, ensuring queries are cleared within one month. Ensure individual bank account funding is at appropriate levels. Preparation of short- and longer-term cash flow summaries. Compile financial data for variance analysis and reporting of results against expectations. Perform less complex analysis. Utilize appropriate tools to obtain data necessary to support financial analysis and create financial transactions. Responsibilities may include extracting and analyzing data. Prepare, evaluate and complete less complex analyses to support financial/business plans, budget and forecasts for the organisation. Engage with US and UK colleagues on cash management initiatives, including process and system changes. Support the continuous improvement of cashiering and cash management processes and controls. Perform other duties as assigned. What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? Good knowledge and experience of cashiering functions. Experience in multi-currency transactions (an advantage). Strong team player with effective communication skills. Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Comfortable operating financial systems related to cashiering and cash accounting. Strong financial controls competence and awareness of risk and compliance. What is a Must Have? Educated to A level (or equivalent). Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., formulas, filters, lookups, pivot tables an advantage). Good time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. What Is in It for You? Private Medical Insuran ce: On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction. Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution. Holiday Entitlement: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year. Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs. Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

Scopely is seeking a
Director, Legal Operations
to join our Legal team. This role will lead the Legal Operations function and establish the strategy, operating model, technology roadmap, governance framework, and performance infrastructure for a global, high-growth Legal department. This role will be a hybrid position in our Culver City, CA hub.
The Director will directly manage the Sr. Manager, Legal Operations, who owns day-to-day Ironclad CLM operations, knowledge management infrastructure, and AI-enabled legal technology implementation. The Director will provide strategic direction, prioritize the team’s roadmap, manage resources and vendors, and remain accountable for the quality, adoption, and business impact of these programs.
This is a senior people-leadership and functional-building role for someone who can translate Legal leadership’s priorities into scalable systems, processes, and measurable outcomes. The right candidate will combine strategic judgment, operational discipline, technical fluency, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted partnerships across Legal and the broader business . as a strategic business partner, not just a support or systems-administration function. They will be comfortable operating in ambiguity, creating structure where none exists, and leading through influence in a fast-paced global gaming company.
What You Will Do
Legal Operations Strategy & Functional Leadership
Partner directly with Legal leadership to define and execute a multi-year Legal Operations strategy aligned with Scopely’s business priorities and growth
Translate Legal department priorities into an integrated roadmap covering technology, process improvement, data, knowledge management, automation, training, and organizational capability
Establish annual and quarterly priorities, success metrics, resource plans, and sequencing recommendations for the Legal Operations team
Advise Legal leadership on tradeoffs among business impact, risk, cost, speed, and available team capacity
Develop the Legal Operations budget, oversee spend, build business cases for new investments, and manage vendor and renewal strategy
Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and simplify Legal processes across Commercial, Corporate, Employment, Product Compliance, and other Legal functions
Directly manage, coach, and develop the Sr. Manager, Legal Operations, who owns Ironclad CLM operations, knowledge management infrastructure, and AI implementation
Legal Technology Strategy & Governance
Serve as the executive owner of Scopely’s Legal technology portfolio and establish a coherent architecture and investment strategy across CLM, knowledge management, matter management, e-billing, contract analytics, automation, and related tools
Own the Legal technology roadmap, including technology selection, implementation sequencing, integration priorities, system rationalization, and long-term scalability
Oversee Ironclad CLM as a critical Legal and business system, ensuring that the Sr. Manager has the direction, resources, governance framework, and stakeholder alignment necessary to operate the platform effectively
Establish governance standards for workflow design, metadata, templates, permissions, approval logic, integrations, repository integrity, data retention, change management, and system access
Review and approve significant platform changes, balancing user experience, business needs, control requirements, data integrity, and long-term maintainability
Partner with IT, Information Security, Privacy, Procurement, Finance, and external vendors on architecture, security, integrations, implementation, support, and risk management
Lead or oversee system migrations, data consolidation efforts, post-acquisition integrations, and other technology transformation initiatives
Knowledge Management, Automation & AI
Establish the strategic vision and operating model for Legal knowledge management, including content architecture, taxonomy, ownership, curation, searchability, version control, and access governance
Ensure that Legal’s institutional knowledge is captured, structured, maintained, and made accessible in ways that support self-service, consistency, and future AI applications
Develop a portfolio of practical AI and automation use cases for Legal in partnership with Legal leadership, IT, and relevant business stakeholders
Oversee the implementation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools, including chatbots, knowledge-based assistants, workflow automation, contract analytics, and other emerging technologies
Direct the Sr. Manager’s hands-on execution of knowledge management and AI initiatives, including platform configuration, testing, content population, user feedback, optimization, and rollout
Define success metrics for AI and automation initiatives, including adoption, response quality, time saved, reduction in repetitive inquiries, and measurable improvements to the Legal user experience
Stay current on legal technology and AI developments and make informed recommendations regarding opportunities, risks, and investment priorities
Process Improvement & Business Partnership
Serve as a strategic partner to Legal leadership, Procurement, Finance, Information Security, IT, People, Product, and other stakeholders to improve the end-to-end process of contracting and Legal support experience
Establish scalable intake, triage, and routing models that direct work to the appropriate Legal or business resource and minimize unnecessary attorney involvement
Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify recurring friction, diagnose root causes, and implement structural solutions rather than one-off fixes
Support Legal leadership to define and adopt practical playbooks, self-service resources, approval frameworks, and standardized workflows
Data, Analytics & Performance Management
Act as a strategic partner with Commercial Legal to design and monitor metrics such as contracting cycle times, intake volumes, routing accuracy, self-service rates, workflow adoption, support trends, system reliability, automation impact, and stakeholder satisfaction
Establish a Legal Operations performance framework that measures the efficiency, quality, adoption, capacity, and business impact of Legal services and systems
Create executive-ready dashboards and reporting for Legal leadership, highlighting trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions
Use data to support capacity planning, prioritization, investment decisions, vendor management, and continuous improvement
What We’re Looking For
7-10+ years of experience in Legal Operations, legal technology, business operations, process transformation, consulting, or a related field, with clear progression in scope, responsibility, and organizational leadership
Demonstrated experience leading or building a Legal Operations function within a high-growth technology, gaming, entertainment, digital media, or similarly complex global company
At least 3–5 years of experience managing, coaching, and developing professionals, including experience setting priorities, delegating ownership, giving feedback, and building team capability
Experience establishing a Legal Operations strategy, operating model, roadmap, budget, governance framework, and performance-measurement program
Significant experience with enterprise CLM programs, including Ironclad or a comparable platform. Direct Ironclad administration experience is strongly preferred; the candidate must have sufficient technical depth to evaluate platform architecture, workflow design, data governance, integrations, controls, and adoption
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, negotiate with vendors, assess technology investments, and measure realized value
Experience overseeing legal technology portfolios beyond CLM, such as knowledge management, e-billing, matter management, contract analytics, automation, compliance, or AI-enabled tools
Proven ability to build or mature a knowledge management function and translate institutional knowledge into structured, searchable, reusable content
Experience evaluating, implementing, governing, or scaling AI and automation tools in a professional-services, legal, technology, or corporate environment
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to identify patterns, diagnose root causes, and design solutions that scale
Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior Legal and business leaders and translate technical or operational issues into clear business decisions
Strong project and change-management skills, including the ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple teams with competing priorities
A highly collaborative, practical, and service-oriented leadership style, with the judgment to balance user experience, business enablement, risk management, and operational discipline
Comfort operating with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and the ability to create clarity, structure, and momentum amid ambiguity
Nice to Have
Experience leading Legal Operations in a gaming, interactive entertainment, digital media, or consumer technology company
Direct experience with Ironclad, contract analytics, legal knowledge platforms, or similar tools
Experience with post-acquisition Legal technology integrations, data migrations, or operating-model integration
Experience managing outside counsel, legal vendors, e-billing, matter management, or Legal department spend
Experience developing responsible-use standards or governance frameworks for AI in a Legal or regulated environment
Experience partnering with geographically distributed teams and supporting global Legal operations
A sense of humor and a passion for mobile gaming
What Success Looks Like
Within the first year, the Director will have established a clear Legal Operations strategy and roadmap; created a well-functioning operating model for the Legal Operations team; enabled the Sr. Manager to own day-to-day CLM, knowledge management, and AI execution; implemented a consistent performance-reporting framework; strengthened governance across Legal technology; and delivered measurable improvements in self-service, workflow adoption, contracting efficiency, and Legal team capacity.

jobs.description: At Amazon, our goal is to exceed the expectations of customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered where and when they need them, as quickly, accurately, and cost efficiently as possible. To meet this goal, Amazon is continually striving to innovate and provide best in class service through the introduction of pioneering new products and services in the last mile delivery space, including the continuous innovation and expansion of Amazon Flex program. Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. We are seeking a Head of Worldwide Marketing & Communications for Amazon Flex. In this role, you will serve as the global leader architecting and overseeing our worldwide marketing and communications vision and strategy across the end-to-end customer lifecycle. This encompasses brand, creative, digital, acquisition, retention, loyalty, product, marketing technology, content, communications, learning experience design, data and analytics, research, and insights. You will lead a team responsible for setting up strategies, systems, mechanisms, processes and programs to support the business in scaling, as well as providing functional expertise that can be used across all locales to improve how we deliver on business goals. This includes owning the global marketing and communications roadmap, advising on country-specific strategies, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that drive growth and engagement while maintaining brand and voice consistency. This is a highly visible position that requires an exceptional leader who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, while delivering measurable results. You will be equally diving deep to deliver short-term tactical executions, as well as thinking big with long-term strategic planning, using data-driven insights to inform decisions. The ideal candidate will bring proven experience managing and scaling marketing and communications globally, strong analytical capabilities, cross-cultural communication skills, and a track record of building and executing sophisticated go-to-market strategies in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. They will possess exemplary written and oral communications skills, and the ability to earn trust with and advise leadership. Key job responsibilities * Drive global marketing and communication vision and strategy, build functional capabilities and roadmaps, and ensure execution excellence to deliver results. * Lead and develop a highly effective marketing and communication organization across the customer lifecycle, including branding, lead generation, conversion, engagement, product, communication, learning experience design, marketing technology, and research and insights. * Analyze market and industry trends, customer behavior, and other relevant data to inform product development and business strategies. * Build scalable and repeatable marketing and communication programs that have broad, but targeted reach. Use lessons learned to create global playbooks, toolkits, and processes than enable programs to scale. * Oversee the development and launch of go-to-market plans for all new products, features, and services for Amazon Flex. * Track, measure, and analyze the performance of marketing and communications campaigns, and report results to business leadership. * Continually experiment and introduce new approaches to marketing and communications that acquire and engage customers in innovative ways. * Balance strategic planning and capability building, with tactical execution to deliver results. * Work closely with and advise leadership on marketing and communications strategies, and ensure alignment with business objectives. * Advise and collaborate efficiently and effectively with the regional business, marketing, and communications teams to support achieving goals. * Partner and collaborate with stakeholders team across product, engineering, program, business development, PR, legal, public policy, business operations, creative, and other Amazon marketing and communications organizations. * Manage budgets, including allocation, reconciliation, and ROI.
